studio: Sony Pictures / Marvel Studios / Columbia Pictures
fair_use_rationale: Non-profit educational and critical film scene analysis under Section 107 of the U.S. Copyright Act. Transformative documentary commentary analyzing the socio-economic motivations of Adrian Toomes (The Vulture), investigating how labor displacement and corporate monopoly drive cinematic antagonism.
